newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan finance minister sees no rupee change.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan finance minister sees no rupee change.

text.p: Pakistan's newly-appointed Finance Minister Naveed Qamar said on Thursday that there would be no change in the rupee rate in the foreseeable future.

Qamar was speaking after the International Monetary Fund and World Bank had signalled approval for a stabilisation package announced on October 22, which both institutions said would clear the way for further financial assistance to Pakistan.
"It should be recognised that the economic policy package that has been implemented included among other things a strong budgetary effort to reduce financial imbalances," he said.
"This, combined with the deliberate overshooting of the latest exchange rate adjustment, obviates any need for further adjustment in the near future," Qamar told a news conference.
Last week's policy package included a 7.86 percent devaluation of the rupee against the dollar, as well as spending cuts, new taxes and a 10 percent rise in oil product prices.
